categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Has the P2P label, modifies `src/net_processing.cpp`, and fixes orphan transaction handling during 1P1C package processing.
categories.rationale: Fixes an invalid `Assume(false)` assertion triggered when an orphan enters the mempool via RPC and is subsequently chosen as a child in 1P1C package processing. As described in the PR, 'An orphan that enters the mempool other than through peer relay (e.g. by RPC) stays in the orphanage... package evaluation then reports it as MEMPOOL_ENTRY, which hit Assume(false)'. This resolves an edge-case debug assertion failure and ensures proper orphanage cleanup.
